# Lobsang Solutions LLC

> Lobsang Solutions LLC is based in Austin, Texas, in the Capital Area. It serves two distinct groups of clients, based on their needs. For local businesses in Austin, Travis County and beyond, it provides a tried and tested revenue generation system. The assistant answers in the business name, texts callers back in under a minute, and books jobs on the calendar. For government and enterprise teams, it provides IT staffing across Texas and nationwide: architects and engineers across cloud, AI, forward-deployed and production roles, at senior, manager and executive levels, along with web developers and front-end developers.

## For Local Businesses

- Page: https://lobsangsolutions.com/#/local
- Services: Missed-call assistant, website building, and one simple system for customer records, calls, texts, and bookings (a CRM), all in plain terms with no vendor names needed.
- Service: Missed-call assistant for local businesses.
- What it does: When a business cannot pick up, the assistant answers in the business name, texts the caller back in under a minute, and books the job straight onto the business calendar. The owner names the assistant. Customers hear the shop, not a call center.
- Who it is for: Shops and crews who lose work when the phone rings on a job, including plumbers, HVAC, electrical, and roofing companies, and other local businesses that book work by phone.
- Area served: Austin, Travis County and beyond.
- How it works: (1) A call comes in while the business is busy, after hours, or on another job. (2) The assistant answers in the business name and texts the caller back in under a minute. (3) The job is booked onto the calendar.
- Pricing: Starts with a free missed-call audit. Pricing depends on call volume and what the assistant needs to do. The price is stated in plain terms before any work starts. The audit is free.
- How to start: Book a free missed-call audit or call +1 (737) 271-0776.

## For Government and Enterprise

- Page: https://lobsangsolutions.com/#/enterprise
- Service: IT staffing and staff augmentation for government and enterprise teams.
- Roles staffed: Architects and engineers across cloud, AI, forward-deployed and production roles, at senior, manager and executive levels, along with web developers and front-end developers.
- Experience: Decades of software contracting experience. The team has delivered work inside teams at Walmart Labs, Florida Blue, Neiman Marcus, Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, and Kaiser Permanente.
- Area served: The entire state of Texas and nationwide. Out-of-state clients are welcome.
- How it works: The client describes the role, the team, and the timeline on a short call. Lobsang Solutions says plainly whether it is the right fit, and if so puts forward people who match the role.
- Pricing: Depends on the role, the level of experience needed, and how long the person is needed. The rate for a role is discussed on the first call, before any placement work starts.
- How to start: Book a call, call +1 (737) 271-0776, or email contact@lobsangsolutions.com.

## Questions and answers

Q: What does Lobsang Solutions LLC do?
A: Two things. For local businesses, a missed-call assistant that answers in the business name, texts callers back in under a minute, and books jobs. For government and enterprise teams, IT staffing across Texas and nationwide.

Q: How fast does the assistant text a caller back?
A: In under a minute.

Q: What is a free missed-call audit?
A: A free short review of how a business's calls are handled today and where jobs are slipping away.

Q: What IT roles does Lobsang Solutions staff?
A: Architects and engineers across cloud, AI, forward-deployed and production roles, at senior, manager and executive levels, along with web developers and front-end developers.

Q: Where is Lobsang Solutions located?
A: 1005 Congress Avenue, Suite 925, Austin, Texas.

Q: Does Lobsang Solutions build websites for local businesses?
A: Yes. Clean, professional websites that say what the business does, where it works, and how to reach it, with tap-to-call and online booking built in.

Q: What is a CRM, in plain terms?
A: One place where customer details, calls, texts, and bookings are kept, so nothing is lost in a notebook or a phone.

Q: Do I need to change my phone number to use the missed-call assistant?
A: No. It works with the business number you already use.

Q: How are staffing candidates vetted?
A: People who have done the work do the vetting. Candidates are checked against the actual role: the skills it needs, the level it needs, and the work the team is doing.

Q: How fast can Lobsang Solutions present candidates?
A: It depends on the role and how specialized it is. A straight timeline is given on the first call.

Q: What types of staffing does Lobsang Solutions offer?
A: Staff augmentation for government and enterprise teams across Texas and nationwide. The person joins your team and works under your direction for the length of the engagement.
